verdict.rationale: Ledgy's docs describe bulk granting, signature workflows, and HRIS data sync at scale (ledgy-docs-9, ledgy-docs-10, ledgy-docs-12), which supports bulk operations in the UI, but this is not framed as an AI-native/API-driven bulk operation capability - the API docs only show single-entity operations (auth, companyCaptable) with no evidence of batch/bulk API endpoints, and no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt is available for programmatic discovery. Missing for 10: documented bulk API endpoints or batch operation support in the API reference, evidence of programmatic (not just UI) bulk actions, and machine-readable API docs (llms.txt/openapi both 404).
